evidence: Manual complete handler-branch source classification; no runtime or Coq theorem
primary_question: Construct or retain a usable walking/crawling/common-ground-slide action AND obtain the required X/Z shove. A numerical Y change alone does not satisfy the movement-action requirement.
ground_entry_summary: Successful shell mounting selects RIDING_SHELL_GROUND but terminates before later pushes. Ordinary bounce then failed shell mount then box supplies a Y snap and X/Z pushes while retaining AIR. Post-shell cap/dialog guards require existing idle/walking; airborne dive pickup still needs AIR_STEP_LANDED to enter its ground action. Later action execution, retention and productive alignment must be checked separately.
scope: Valid distinct Mario/actor storage; ordinary initialized interaction-type values; completed defined calls. The full action handler executes later. Frozen clones inherit live interaction fields, not novel handlers or automatic native status resets.

definitions.velocity: Speed fields change; this alone is not coordinate motion
definitions.returns: false continues fixed type table; true stops it, whether or not action changed
definitions.graphics_collision: gfx.pos and Mario object's oPos are separate; metadata writes do not move them
definitions.stock: Reviewed SSL Area 1 placements and native child sources, not a proof of all possible cross-area/corrupt histories

callback_supplement.phase: POLELIKE after collision detection, before Mario geometry
callback_supplement.effect: Stock palm tree adds C-relative X/Z displacement to M; no floor query/action/Y/C/D write. Fresh geometry follows. Frozen non-HOLDABLE tree loses callback. Radius70; timer>10; raw vertical range; action mask0x100000.

callback_supplement.phase: After SURFACE, before collision detection and Mario geometry
callback_supplement.effect: Previously captured platform changes M, not action; fresh cache follows. Translation uses VelX/Z, not VelY. Rotation requires nonzero angular-velocity fields.
Native face pitch/roll changes do not set angular velocities. Zero-rotation carry has no Y change. Actual mesh loading/support and a real actor/history remain required.
Large/exclamation box callbacks update actors/meshes/children; no identified direct Mario push. Later wall/floor resolution is part of Mario geometry/step.

callback_supplement.phase: POLELIKE after collision detection, before Mario
callback_supplement.effect: Callback moves/scales actor and clears status; capture later ends interactions. Mario tornado action moves M, copies D; exit TWIRLING.
Goomba/Pokey/Fly Guy/Klepto motion/status/size concern actors. Shared object-object collision explicitly excludes Mario; Klepto cap theft changes flags/save state, not Mario XYZ/action.

callback_supplement.phase: After Mario; drop/throw inside Mario code
callback_supplement.effect: Crazy Box/Bob-omb/small-box motion and HOLP drop/throw place the actor. HOLDABLE does not automatically freeze its native callback. Crazy-box Mario bounce is an airborne action path.

callback_supplement.phase: LEVEL after Mario; IN_CANNON inside Mario
callback_supplement.effect: Callback moves cannon. Mario action sets M at cannon, copies D; firing requires A_PRESSED and selects SHOT_FROM_CANNON.

Can request READING_NPC_DIALOG only through readiness guard: waiting/stationary/moving, excluding riding-shell/invulnerable/first-person. No callback XYZ write; later dialog copies D and exits IDLE/HOLD_IDLE/cap.
IDLE only after below-floor snap or collided wall at/below floor+20. Below-pole exit is FREEFALL and can undo ceiling clamp by restoring raw actorbase Y; copies M to D. Z exit SOFT_BONK.
Star spawn changes time-stop/camera/actor state; pillar detector changes top counter. No identified direct Mario ground-action/XYZ constructor; freeze changes scheduling and surface lifetime.

Cylinder pushes from chest/bookend/chair/Koopa/piano/penguin/snowman/water-bomb cannon; set_mario_pos from Dorrie/tilting inverted pyramid. Butterfly temporarily writes C then subtracts offsets, without a claimed bitwise cancellation. These actors are absent from reviewed SSL1. No sphere helper found. Not inherited by unrelated clones.

unhandled_values.effect: Defined in interaction.h but absent from the dispatch table; no source writer found. No Mario handler effect. An overlapping actor can still consume collision-list capacity.
No interaction-table bit or handler. Behavior callbacks, loaded surfaces and object-list collision bookkeeping are separate mechanisms.
